editorial:
Imagine being the greatest dancer in the world but feeling like a prisoner in your own life. You get to see that struggle here as you follow Nijinsky, a man who is a superstar on stage but totally lost off of it. He is caught in a messy love triangle between his controlling boss and a young ballerina who wants him for herself. The whole movie feels very lush and dramatic, focusing on the pressure of fame and the secrets he has to keep just to survive in a world that does not understand him.

What really works is the acting and the beautiful dance scenes that make you feel the energy of the music. The pacing is a bit slow in some spots, but the emotional tension keeps you interested. If you enjoy stories about artists and forbidden love, you will really like this. It is a great pick for a quiet movie night.
endingExplained: The story ends on a sad note as you see Nijinsky lose his grip on reality. After years of pressure and mental struggle, he suffers a complete breakdown. He ends up spending the rest of his life in a mental hospital, far away from the stage and the fame he once had. The movie wraps up by showing that his genius came with a heavy price, leaving him broken and alone in his final days.
targetAudience: Ideal for anyone who loves stories about artists and tragic romance.
